network_audit.attribution: Optional urllib3 IPv6-probe compatibility, not E48 event attribution proof.
network_audit.scope: Python audit-hook events only; native Node guard separately checked; no host/argument values retained.

reader_state.scope: Owned worker physical termination and descendant closure are verified by outer dispatch.

resources.cgroup_scope: Shared cgroup; not candidate incremental use; peak may predate this run.
resources.scope: SELF excludes child CPU; CHILDREN RSS is largest child high-water, not sum.

score_semantics: Stable FP64 log_softmax of observed contract-domain FP32 head logits; whole_source selects one unchanged forecast at max(1-pNotMentioned), ties earliest window; no clipping.
timing_scope: Per-row sum of measured prepacking and actual forward(s); whole batch includes all source/hash/init/BGE/native/cleanup. Whole_source includes all window forwards.
